深程传感器探测到了一段有规律的信号传输，其源头已准确定位于一个遥远的黑洞系统。

这种模式让我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]陷入了沉思。这种刻意且严谨的精确性，与我们观测舰船跨越事件视界时记录的特征相吻合。虽然这并非同一个信号，但其相似之处是毋庸置疑的。

[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]请求我们前往源头星系，查明那里留下了什么。
texts.en:
Deep-range sensors have detected a structured transmission, its point of origin triangulated to a distant black hole system.

The pattern gave our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] pause. The deliberate, constructed precision matches the signature recorded when we observed a vessel crossing an event horizon. This is not the same signal. But the similarity is unmistakable.

[owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName] is petitioning us to set course for the source system and find out what was left there.

texts.zh:
深程传感器探测到了一段有规律的信号传输，其源头已准确定位于一个遥远的黑洞系统。

我们无法从这里解析该信号。[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]坚信这值得我们开展直接调查，并请求我们设定航线前往源头星系，以解码该传输信号。
texts.en:
Deep-range sensors have detected a structured transmission, its point of origin triangulated to a distant black hole system.

We cannot resolve the signal from here. [owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName] is convinced this warrants direct investigation, and is petitioning us to set course for the source system and decode the transmission.

texts.zh: 从一个遥远的黑洞系统中探测到了一个来源不明的结构化信号。我们必须展开调查。
texts.en: A structured signal of unknown origin has been detected from a distant black hole system. We must investigate.

texts.zh:
当我们进入[solar_system.GetName]星系时，我们发现了一个巨大的晶态栅格阵列。我们的 [Owner.GetScientistPlural]已经确认，它存在于近乎完美的时空停滞状态中，并定期从引力边界传输结构化数据。

这不是自然现象。它是一份记录，是那些已不复存在的文明跨越时空的呼唤，一份被保存下来的叙述。

[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]正准备接收并破译这些传输信号。
texts.en:
As we crossed into the [solar_system.GetName] system, we discovered a massive, crystalline lattice formation. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have already confirmed that it exists in near-perfect temporal stasis, transmitting structured data from the gravitational boundary at regular intervals.

This is not a natural phenomena. It is a record, the preserved account of civilizations that no longer exist, calling out across time.

[owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName] is preparing to receive and decode the transmissions.

label.zh: 完成项目与合同后，方舟首次进入另一个黑洞星系
label.en: After the project and contract are completed, on the arkship's first entry into another black-hole system

texts.zh:
当信号传来时，[solar_system.GetName]黑洞早已出现在我们的扫描仪上。其次谐波特征与我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]通过“永恒合唱”晶格发送的信息完全吻合：

记录已接收并保存。你加入了这里汇聚的、跨越无数时代的万千心声。每一个留下记录的文明都曾以为自己是孤独的。但事实并非如此。合唱的规模远超他们任何一方的想象。它仍在继续。

有什么东西接收了我们的记录。并且做出了回应。
texts.en:
The [solar_system.GetName] black hole was already on our scanners when the transmission arrived. The sub-harmonic signature matches exactly what our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] sent through the Eternal Chorus lattice:

Record received and preserved. You join thousands of voices gathered here across uncounted ages. Every civilisation that added its account believed itself alone. None of them were. The chorus is larger than any of them knew. It continues.

Something received our record. And it answered.

texts.zh:
[owner.GetScientistCapital][from.GetName]无法再继续开展“永恒合唱”信号的调查。

此人的志向已传承给[owner.GetScientistCapital][eternal_chorus_leader.GetName]，后者已同意接替上任继续进行这项研究。
texts.en:
[owner.GetScientistCapital] [from.GetName] can no longer continue the investigation into the Eternal Chorus signal.

Their ambition has passed to [owner.GetScientistCapital] [eternal_chorus_leader.GetName], who has agreed to take up the research in their place.

texts.zh:
[owner.GetScientistCapital][from.GetName]无法再继续开展“永恒合唱”信号的调查。

由于没有其他人愿意接手这项工作，合约已无法履行。
texts.en:
[owner.GetScientistCapital] [from.GetName] can no longer continue the investigation into the Eternal Chorus signal.

With no others willing to carry the work forward, the Contract cannot be fulfilled.

# 永恒合唱 / The Eternal Chorus

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/nomads_arkship_events.txt, common/missions/missions/02_contracts.txt, common/special_projects/06_projects_nomads.txt, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

游牧帝国的方舟随机事件池 mobile_arkship_random_events（00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006，总权重460）；由隐藏事件 arkship.1（nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49）定期调用：游戏前5年不会触发，之后每次约三分之一概率（无事则3–5年后再试；近期参战、或所有方舟都在战斗时概率为0），再从方舟殖民地中抽取一个触发该事件池（nomads_effects.txt:96-117）。
The nomad arkship random pool mobile_arkship_random_events (00_on_actions.txt:3979-4006, total weight 460) is drawn by hidden arkship.1 (nomads_arkship_events.txt:7-49): never in the first 5 years, afterwards about one try in three (retry in 3-5 years otherwise; zero during a recent war or while every arkship is fighting), then a random arkship colony fires the pool (nomads_effects.txt:96-117).
arkship.140（lines 1878-1972，池中权重 20/460）：全局尚无“永恒合唱”进行中（eternal_chorus_active）、非格式塔、本国未发生过、拥有科学家。它选一位科学家作为监督者（并防止其被其他事件杀死），在另一个黑洞星系设置目标，并签发自接合同 contract_eternal_chorus。
arkship.140 needs: no Eternal Chorus running anywhere, non-gestalt owner, not done before, a scientist. It picks the lead scientist, marks another black-hole system as target and issues the self-issued contract.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. arkship.140 “遥远的信号”：唯一选项接受合同（同时开启事件链“永恒合唱”；若之前发生过“黑洞现象”正文不同）。
   A Distant Signal: the single option accepts the contract and opens the event chain.
2. 前往目标星系：方舟进入目标黑洞星系时触发 arkship.141 “晶体晶格”（on_entering_system，00_on_actions.txt:964）；合同接受时启用项目“永恒合唱”（02_contracts.txt:4972-4985），项目完成触发 arkship.145（在项目故事“永恒合唱”中：完成合同或取消合同）。
   Entering the target system fires arkship.141 Crystal Lattice; accepting the contract starts the project that fires arkship.145 (see the project story).
3. 合同成功后：方舟首次进入另一个黑洞星系时触发 arkship.150 “回答”，获得团结与社会研究加成并结束事件链。
   After the contract succeeds, the arkship's first entry into another black-hole system fires arkship.150 An Answer (unity and society research), ending the chain.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- arkship.142 “条款变更”：监督科学家被解雇或死亡时（on_leader_fired / on_leader_death，00_on_actions.txt:2403、2430）改派另一名科学家；没有其他科学家则结束事件链。
  A Change in Terms: if the lead scientist is fired or dies the chain moves to another scientist or ends.
- arkship.145 的选项 a 履行合同（领袖得到经验和特质，合同进度 +1）、b 取消合同（团结加成，事件链结束）。
  arkship.145 (in the project story): fulfil the contract, or cancel it for unity.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 全局同时只能进行一条“永恒合唱”（eternal_chorus_active，合同停止时清除）。
  Only one Eternal Chorus can run in the whole galaxy at a time.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：arkship.140-150、合同 contract_eternal_chorus（02_contracts.txt:4938-5038）、项目 ARKSHIP_ETERNAL_CHORUS_PROJECT（06_projects_nomads.txt:1793-1819）与 on_action 调用。
- 更正 Corrections：原先 140、141、142、150 是四个互不相连的单页故事；它们是同一条合同链的四个时刻，现合并为一个故事。
  Four unconnected one-card stories were the moments of one contract chain and are merged.
- 请求 Request：中间的 arkship.145 位于另一审阅者的项目故事（project-arkship-eternal-chorus-project）中，建议协调员把它并入本故事。
  arkship.145 sits in another reviewer's project story; the coordinator may merge it here.
